description: EVCN-Simulator: An Open-Source Agent-Based Simulator for Electric-Vehicle Charging-Network Resilience under Prolonged Urban Power Outages is a software deposit deposited in Zenodo by its authors Mohamed Abdelfattah (Technische Universität Berlin). EVCN-Simulator is a research software package for studying electric-vehicle charging networks during long power outages. An electric-vehicle charging network is the set of charging stations, driver charging decisions, station queues, and local power-grid limits that determine whether drivers can continue to charge their vehicles during a disruption. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge but the files are restricted according to the repository (Zenodo access right: restricted). The licence is MIT. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
